T-01.detail: An FK needs both join_table and join_column.

T-02.detail: Status and Category apply only on int4/int8 columns.

T-03.detail: An FK to a system table gets the system type, whatever the column type; safe only after the view-FK inference fix (v0.76.10).

T-07.detail: Point is GeoPoint, Polygon is GeoPolygon, anything else is Unknown with no data_type check; MultiPolygon stays Unknown (backlog: a MultiPolygon type with its own editor).

T-08.detail: int2 is IntegerNumber, or an FK.

T-09.detail: A uuid FK to a table with display_name is ForeignKeyName once the FK editor is checked for uuid keys; a plain uuid stays display-only TextShort (backlog: a Uuid type with formatting rules when there is no FK).

T-11.detail: Stays Unknown; reopen as a feature once the FK editor supports non-integer keys.

T-12.detail: The MCP gains M:M detection; its formatter may still leave the embeds out.

S-01.detail: The FK embed selects join_column, not id.

S-02.detail: Evidence-gated: curl showed PostgREST embeds statuses!col and categories!col through the public views (client-intake 200 with data, neighborhood-hub and staff-portal 200, a nonexistent column 400 PGRST200), so the core adopts the MCP names.

S-03.detail: The User embed includes phone and email (RLS governs), with a test that the MCP formatter trims them.

S-04.detail: One File embed; the MCP formatter stays compact.

S-05.detail: The Payment embed includes refunds, errors and created_at.

S-07.detail: Select the key once; approved diff on the 4 staff-portal instances, done with S-01.

V-01.detail: Create and edit exclude created_at and updated_at.

V-03.detail: Structural columns appear in every fetch plan.

V-04.detail: The map property appears in the list plan.

C-01.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

C-04.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

A-01.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

A-02.detail: Not a divergence: an MCP feature gap.

A-03.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

E-01.detail: Core exports an ErrorKind union plus DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGES satisfies Record<ErrorKind, ...> built from today's frontend wording; consumers pass partial overrides (the MCP keeps its wording, the frontend moves to i18n keys at P3a.2).

E-03.detail: The fallback message is the humanized sentence plus the raw constraint name, on every fallback path in both consumers; English, i18n is backlog.

E-04.detail: The UI keeps "System Error" and the frontend logs the full error to the console; the MCP keeps the raw message.

Q-01.detail: Default order is display_name then id, plus an ",id.asc" tie-breaker; the largest harness diff.

Q-02.detail: Transport policy: the core query carries limit, offset and a count flag; the app uses Range only on paginated reads, the MCP uses Range plus count.

Q-03.detail: The ",id" tie-breaker is appended, not prepended (also settles the duplicate id append).

Q-11.detail: Include id only when the entity has one.

Q-04.detail: Sorting an FK sorts by display_name.

Q-05.detail: Live check: bare wfts. and wfts(simple). return different rows, and the right config is per column, so one hybrid builder takes an optional per-entity text-search config and sends bare wfts. without one; the MCP display_name ilike fallback is an opt-in builder option.

Q-06.detail: Keep the sort while searching in core; ListPage stops clearing the sort in Phase 2 (P2a).

Q-07.detail: Trim search terms and skip blank ones.

Q-08.detail: A null filter value becomes is.null; an empty string is dropped.

Q-09.detail: Several filters on one column become and=(col.gte.a,col.lt.b); an approved harness diff, with a live check on whether ISO timestamps inside and=() need quoting; OR already comes from search and in.(), so no filter-tree feature is needed.

Q-10.detail: Core validates integers, limit >= 1 and offset >= 0; the maximum is consumer policy (MCP 100, app 1000 for calendars).

Q-12.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

Q-13.detail: The MCP reads the core detail plan by default (visible, structural and condition-field columns) and gains a fields parameter for extra columns, validated against the schema.

Q-14.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

Q-16.detail: Core reports an unknown total as null; the app keeps its row-count fallback and the MCP omits it.

N-01.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

N-02.detail: Resolve status_key first, then display name, in one core resolver used by the MCP and the import worker; no example needs an import change today.

N-03.detail: Trim the FK name lookup in core.

N-04.detail: Confirmed MCP bug; fixed on main in b3f2eeb8.

N-05.detail: Deferred: a per-session MCP locale is an MCP product feature.

N-06.detail: Report duplicate display names as ambiguous, listing the candidates.

X-01.detail: Core transforms take an explicit zone: for timestamptz the MCP requires an ISO value with an offset and rejects offset-less values with an instructive error, DateTime stays wall-clock verbatim, and money and files are normalized through core.

X-02.detail: The 3 admin pages migrate in Phase 2.

F-01.detail: Encode filter values and entityId in core; the MCP stops re-encoding at P1.4.

F-02.detail: page and pageSize must be integers >= 1.

F-03.detail: An invalid DateTimeLocal control value becomes empty, not NaN.

F-04.detail: Keep specific messages for 23502, 22P02, 22007/8 and 412; English, i18n is backlog.

F-17.detail: Friendly messages for 23503 and PGRST116 on both sides; PT503 stays with the maintenance interceptor; English, i18n is backlog.

F-05.detail: Evidence-gated: PostgreSQL 17.5 resolves New York 02:30 to 03:30 EDT as the frontend does, so the forward shift stays.

F-06.detail: Transforms handle 19-character values, with new cases in e2e:integrity.

F-07.detail: The edit select keeps parent hops.

F-09.detail: Reject invalid local times with a UI error path, not a silent drop.

F-10.detail: Explicit parse rules for dates and offset-less values, covered by the TZ matrix.

F-11.detail: Parse money output explicitly, or reject it.

F-13.detail: Quote items containing ",().:\"" and drop empty items; in.() stays "matches nothing" and eq.false and eq.0 stay.

F-14.detail: One Content-Range parser (already in core; settled by Q-16).

F-15.detail: A generic fallback for P0001 without a message, and an explicit status-over-code precedence in core.

F-16.detail: One evaluator with an explicit coercion option (string for guided forms, strict for actions); neq against null follows the action evaluator.
